module.title: Dependencies
module.intro: Packages declared in package.json or Cargo.toml that nothing in their project names: no import, no configuration file, no script. Uncached only reports them. Removing one is a command you run yourself.
module.noWorkspace: Choose a folder in Workspace first. Dependencies are read from the projects it finds there.
module.failed: The dependencies could not be read.
module.none: Every declared dependency is named somewhere in its project.
module.noneAtThisLevel: Nothing at high confidence. Show every level to see the ones a tool may load without naming them.

scope.highHint: Only the ones nothing in the project explains
scope.allHint: Also the ones a tool may load without naming them

reasons.notReferenced: Nothing in the project names it.
reasons.conventionLoaded: A tool may load it by a short name, the way ESLint loads plugins.
reasons.commandOnly: It installs a command no script runs. It may be run by hand.
reasons.typesOnly: Type definitions, which the compiler can use without an import.
reasons.featuresOrLinkage: It may be declared only to turn on features or link a native library.
reasons.notInstalled: Not installed here, so the commands it provides and the packages that expect it could not be checked.
reasons.incompleteScan: The project has more files than one reading covers.

toolchains.title: Toolchain versions no project uses
toolchains.intro: Versions installed by nvm, fnm, rustup, pyenv or SDKMAN that no project here pins and no manager uses by default. Each comes with the manager's own uninstall command.
toolchains.none: Every installed toolchain version is pinned by a project or is a default.
toolchains.failed: Could not read the installed toolchains.
toolchains.locked_other: {{count}} versions no project uses, {{size}} in all.
toolchains.lockedHint: Uncached Pro lists each one with the command that removes it.
toolchains.found_other: {{count}} versions no project uses, {{size}} in all
